message.content: {"title":"AERO9500 Final Report (Part 2) - T3 2020 Assignment","overview":"Design a space mission benefiting Australia and identify main elements of its space segment, demonstrating understanding of launch, orbits and space systems via preliminary mission plan using software (STK, PIGI, or other) supplemented by hand calculations.","deliverables":["Technical report as single PDF including appendix","Relevant screenshots and all STK or PIGI design files (in appendix or included with report)"],"format":{"length":"20 pages max for core part, excluding title page, table of contents, references, appendix","structure":"Executive summary; Introduction - mission overview and rationale; Main body - all sections describing mission's space segment e.g. launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation and end-of-life; Conclusion; Bibliography; Appendix (screenshots, STK/PIGI files)","other":"Clear, effective engineering report writing style with correct grammar and spelling; Figures and tables fully and correctly labelled with number, title and reference if necessary; All non-original text/diagrams/ideas cited and referenced, Wikipedia not allowed as proper source"},"requirements":[{"id":"R1","text":"Define spacecraft's primary mission, must benefit Australia, keep concept simple (examples: bushfire tracking and alert, weather satellite, internet/communication, earth observation for city planning/real estate)"},{"id":"R2","text":"State whether mission uses one or multiple spacecraft"},{"id":"R3","text":"Identify users (operator and customers)"},{"id":"R4","text":"Specify launch location and launch vehicle"},{"id":"R5","text":"Specify orbit type, its characteristics and orbital elements"},{"id":"R6","text":"Determine if any orbital maneuvers are required"},{"id":"R7","text":"Identify which ground control facilities will be used and how often spacecraft can communicate with ground control"},{"id":"R8","text":"Define mission duration and plans for end-of-life (EOL)"},{"id":"R9","text":"Use software of choice for design (STK, PIGI requiring competition registration for license, or other with instructor approval) supplemented with hand calculations"},{"id":"R10","text":"Cover in main body space segment elements: launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation and end-of-life"}]}
